headline: TOR @ CHC matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is TOR 4.45 at CHC 4.62, with a projected total of 9.07. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward CHC: TOR moved +0.15 runs while CHC moved +0.56, changing the projected margin by -0.41 runs. The projected total climbed +0.76, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability dropped -11.5%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Patrick Corbin has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Pete Crow-Armstrong, Seiya Suzuki, Nathan Lukes, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Myles Straw because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
